move: fourteen rounded rings rush inward, shrinking, rotating and colour-cycling
how: Fourteen rounded-square outlines sit centred on near-black with a glowing white core and a vignette. A seek function gives each ring phase (p + i/14) mod 1: it is born at scale 4.2 beyond the frame, rushes inward with an ease-out to scale 0.12 at the core, turns 90deg in transit plus a full 360 field spin per D, fades in fast and out with a cubic, thickens from 2 to 8px, cycles hue by 220deg along the trip plus a full turn per D, and sinks in z. The core pulses scale 1.18 once per ring birth and rotates once per D. Everything is periodic so the 6s loop closes.
adapt: Change the ring shape (border-radius), count N, stroke colours (fix the hue or use the brand palette) and the core mark. Keep the phase-offset pipeline and the power-2.2 inward ease so rings bunch near the centre.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the ring divs and core; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear progress tween over D whose onUpdate gsap.sets scale, rotation, opacity, borderColor, borderWidth and z per ring, replacing fx.register. Ring size 360px is fixed; scale to the shot.
caveats: motion is a seek function, not tweens; port as a progress tween with onUpdate
rotation ph*90 relies on the fourfold symmetry of the rounded square
